answer: Require every new account to solve a sequential proof-of-work puzzle bound to its hardware key on the tide before it can post, taking about ten minutes of work that cannot be split across machines. Rotate the puzzle seed every epoch on the ledge so solutions cannot be precomputed or reused, and bind each solution to the account's attested device key on the signal, so one device can only ever vouch for one live account. A Sybil farmer minting a thousand accounts then pays a thousand sequential puzzles and a thousand hardware keys, while an honest newcomer pays ten minutes once.
